cohort: A total of 1190 neonates suspected of intracranial haemorrhage after cranial ultrasound screening from one tertiary hospital, with an additional 91 neonates from another tertiary hospital for external validation.
finding: A nomogram predicting neonatal intracranial haemorrhage based on Platelet count, gestational diabetes, mode of delivery, amniotic fluid contamination, and 1-min Apgar score demonstrated good discrimination and calibration across training and validation cohorts.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant variable for establishing the predictive model for neonatal intracranial haemorrhage.
